title: Optimal Partition of String
summary: For a string s, divide it into the smallest number of substrings where each substring contains unique characters.
statement: For a string s, divide it into the smallest number of substrings where each substring contains unique characters. Each character must appear in exactly one substring.
constraints: Partition the nonempty string into contiguous substrings.
Every substring must contain no repeated character.
Return the minimum number of substrings.
hints: Scan while storing characters in the current part.
When the next character is already present, a cut is mandatory before it.
Increment the part count, clear the set, then add the current character to the new part.
Cutting earlier cannot avoid any mandatory repeat or reduce future cuts, so cutting exactly at each first conflict is optimal.
editorial: Cutting earlier cannot avoid any mandatory repeat or reduce future cuts, so cutting exactly at each first conflict is optimal.

tests.explanation: Greedy cuts before each repeated character produce four valid pieces, and fewer cannot avoid those repeats.
Every repeated s must begin a new substring, giving six parts.
